pages.title: Magic Page
pages.text:
A piece of paper inscribed with a spell, resembling a loose page torn from a spellbook.
Right-click to import the spell from this page into your spell library.

$(l)Generating a Magic Page$()
You can generate a magic page by exporting a spell while holding a piece of paper.

$(l)Spell Submission$()
If you are confident in the quality of your spell and would like its page to appear as loot in chests, you can leave a comment on the CurseForge or MC百科 (mcmod.cn) page, or send me a private message directly.
